snippet.title: Midnight Moving Crew - Steam Co-op Official Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Grab your crew and try not to break everything before sunrise! 🛋️✨ The Midnight Moving Crew playtest is officially live, and we are so excited to share our brand-new trailer with you.

Whether you're speedrunning a couch down a narrow hallway or dealing with unexpected late-night chaos, moving has never been this chaotic (or fun).

👉 Wishlist & Join the Playtest on Steam, Link in Bio
